query: 水风险评估 水风险评估 衡量企业识别、评估和管理水风险的体系成熟度。 内容质量得分 (取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：使用了专业风险识别工具（如 WRI Aqueduct），具备水压力情景分析，有针对高风险站点的应对措施，且建立了水资源治理机制（如首席水官或专项考核）。 • 1分（合格）：有基础的水风险识别和定性描述，具备通用性应对措施（如节水计划），但缺乏针对性工具应用或深度的情景评估。 • 0分（不合格）：无水风险评估披露，或仅笼统提及“重视水资源保护”。 水风险评估 水压力 基准水压力 水资源短缺 干旱风险 洪涝风险 流域风险 高水压力地区 高风险站点 水压力情景分析 WRI Aqueduct WWF水风险过滤器 water risk assessment water stress baseline water stress water scarcity drought risk flood risk basin risk high water stress areas high-risk sites water stress scenario WRI Aqueduct WWF Water Risk Filter 企业是否使用专业水风险工具（如WRI Aqueduct）识别水风险？ 是否按流域、运营点或高水压力区域开展评估？ 是否包含水压力情景分析？ 对高风险站点采取了哪些针对性应对措施？ 是否建立水资源治理机制（如专项职责或考核）？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '水风险评估'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 企业是否使用专业水风险工具（如WRI Aqueduct）识别水风险？ 是否按流域、运营点或高水压力区域开展评估？ 是否包含水压力情景分析？ 对高风险站点采取了哪些针对性应对措施？ 是否建立水资源治理机制（如专项职责或考核）？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有笼统“重视节水”；仅有用水效益目标而无风险评估；仅有排污合规数据；仅有社区饮水公益项目；区分：水风险评估关注风险识别工具、情景与高风险站点应对；用水效益目标与行动方案关注节水量化目标及工程/管理措施，二者不可互相替代。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: Transition risks Changes in regulations | As China seeks to achieve carbon neutrality by 2060, many industries have been affected by new regulations such as energy efficiency benchmarks. As Home Control has manufacturing facilities in China, our manufacturing costs may increase as a result. Home Control frequently monitors the regulatory changes under current ISO14001 system requirements. Additionally, we conduct cross function assessments against the latest regulatory changes reported by third-party service agency such as SGS Hong Kong Limited. Changes in consumer expectations | There is a growing consciousness of environmental issues among consumers around the world. Accordingly, we may be affected by an increase in demand for environmentally- friendly products, and would need to ensure that we are well-positioned to turn this into a business opportunity. Currently, one of our key perpetual targets is to meet our customers' environmental requirements related to their products. Home Control has also dedicated an Environmental and Sustainability team to manage customer's environmental requirements on product level. Furthermore, a cross function 'Green Team' has been established for the study and implementation of environmentally friendly technologies and new materials on our product. Physical risks Extreme weather events | The sixth assessment report by the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) has indicated that at the current rate of global warming, there would likely be an increased frequency of extreme weather events. For Home Control, this could mean potential disruptions in our supply chains. With regards to the management of supply chain disruption risks due to extreme weather events, Home Control has implemented/in the process of implementing the following: • Contingency plans to buffer from the effects of sudden bad weather events. The addition cost of production from contingency plan will be included in the Bill of Materials (BOM). • Supply risks assessment and tracking system that has been developed to help monitor and detect abnormal situation.

results.text: Currently, there is a high composition of plastic material in our products, with plastic making up 30 to 40% of our final product by weight, contributing to high CO 2 emissions. To reduce the impact of our products on the environment and mitigate the potential climate-related risks identified, Home Control has formed a committee and set policies to recommend the use of recycled materials and PCR resin in products to customers. In the year, we managed to increase the ratio of PCR resin within our products by 2.09% from FY2020, thereby reducing CO 2 emissions by 11.38 tonnes. Currently, there is a high composition of plastic material in our products, with plastic making up 30 to 40% of our final product by weight, contributing to high CO 2 emissions. To reduce the impact of our products on the environment and mitigate the potential climate-related risks identified, Home Control has formed a committee and set policies to recommend the use of recycled materials and PCR resin in products to customers. In the year, we managed to increase the ratio of PCR resin within our products by 2.09% from FY2020, thereby reducing CO 2 emissions by 11.38 tonnes. We currently also have a strong business continuity plan for our supply chains, described on page 19 of this report, under 'Supply chains and Business continuity'.
